dialogue.text: We will take turns throwing a card from our hand onto the opponent's table cards, trying to flip it.
The first player to flip all 6 of their table cards wins.
There are three card types: Tsunami, Volcano, and Earthquake. Each one has strengths and weaknesses.
Tsunami beats Volcano, Volcano beats Earthquake, and Earthquake beats Tsunami. Like rock-paper-scissors.
Picking the right type greatly increases your flip chance: 95% if strong, 50% if same type, and only 5% if weak.
But remember, table card types are hidden until they are revealed.
Throw your leftmost throwing card at my leftmost table card by pressing the Throw button.
